author: D

components.title: Filter valid orders and deduplicate
components.what: Keep only shipped or pending orders, remove exact duplicate order rows, and compute revenue as units times unit_price for each remaining order.

components.title: Aggregate revenue by customer
components.what: Sum revenue per customer_id and identify the single highest-revenue customer and their total revenue.

components.title: Compute percentage of total revenue
components.what: Divide the highest customer revenue by total valid revenue and express as a percentage to one decimal place.

challenges.problem: The draft does not show a systematic scan of all 70+ order rows for duplicates; it's possible another exact duplicate was missed, which would change totals and the final percentage.

C101's total (13,854.30) is reasonably close; a single misclassified order (e.g., if O2781's status were misread as pending vs cancelled) could flip the ranking, so the margin should be stress-tested.
Rounding at intermediate per-customer sums (two decimals each) could introduce cumulative rounding drift before dividing; the final percentage should be computed from unrounded raw totals.
